settings.fabric_care_text: 8.9 oz heavyweight fleece — 80% organic combed ring-spun cotton, 20% recycled polyester. Brushed soft on the inside. Cold wash inside-out, tumble dry low or lay flat. The embroidered heart is built to last as long as the hoodie does.
settings.give_comfort_text: Send softness straight to someone holding a lot — no price, no packing slip. At checkout, add their address and write a few words. We ship directly to them with a handwritten card, nothing that mentions money.
